property: NewReno modifies Reno fast recovery so partial ACKs during recovery trigger retransmission of the next presumed missing segment without exiting recovery.

date_or_range.notes: The mechanism predates RFC 6582; the RFC records the mature specification.

sources.supports: Reno ancestry and NewReno partial-ACK behavior

negative_claims: This edge does not make NewReno a new TCP wire version.
The RFC publication date is not the mechanism's first implementation date.
open_questions: Recover early NewReno implementation and deployment chronology.
